label: funes.world — Gaussian splats of built heritage (streamed SOG, via /stream)
attribution: © funes.world and its contributors, CC BY-NC 4.0
source: https://funes.world — an archive of photogrammetry of human-made places (2,432 entities in November 2026). Most are single-file meshes; the ones re-made as Gaussian splats are published as streamed SOG (lod-meta.json, written by splat-transform) on cdn.funes.world. On 2026-11-19 two entities had a streamed-SOG model; both are listed. The list is kept by hand: the site's robots.txt disallows /api/, the only place that names a model's files.
note: CC BY-NC 4.0 on every entry: the set as a whole is non-commercial too. Scenes are in a local frame: each is placed at its entity's coordinates by the median of its splats (center=1: the files' own origins are arbitrary, and stray splats reach 20 km; strays=0 leaves those out, Pompeii's sky box among them), at the SRTM ground height there (alt), Y-up as read off the data (Pompeii from the way splats rise off the ground, Xiaoxitian from side views of its points: eaves, pagodas and niches stand upright with +Y up); heading and scale are not known, so a scene sits at its site but is not aligned to the imagery.
